message.content:
This appears to be a CBP ruling on a set (GRI 3(b)) of a bag with an ozone generator. The essential character is most likely given by the ozone generator, which does the sterilizing and deodorizing. An ozone generator is classified in 8543.70 (electrical machines with individual functions), though ozone therapy apparatus falls under 9019. An ozonizer for air treatment is covered by 8421.39 (air purifying machinery), but a corona plate ozone generator is typically 8543.70.

I recall CBP ruling N301... on "Ozone generator bag kits", which classified the kit under 8543.70.9960. The ozone generator is the essential character, so the kit goes there.

8543.70.9960 is "Other: Other: Other" under the 8543.70.99 subheading. I'm fairly confident, but the exact statistical suffix is from memory.

{"hts_code": "8543.70.9960", "reason": "The bag and ozone generator are a retail set under GRI 3(b), and the ozone generator imparts the essential character, so the set is classified as an electrical machine with individual function in 8543.70."}
